competences.description: Attacks the enemy, dealing more damage according to your MAX HP. Removes 1 beneficial effect with a 30% chance and puts the target to sleep for 1 turn with a 30% chance. You will also fall asleep after attacking.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)

competences.description: You can use skills while sleeping. Your Attack Speed is increased by 30% and recovers HP of all allies by 20% of your MAX HP when you use a skill while sleeping. In addition, decreases HP of the enemy that wakes up from sleep due to taking damage or getting a turn by 10%. [Automatic Effect]
Removes sleep from all allies, except yourself, if you get a turn while sleeping. In addition, recovers HP of the allies with sleep removed by 30% each. [Automatic Effect]
